Separate nighttime Gomez encounter: follow the ghost cat from the Grayson shopfront toward the cemetery. Use Light at the candle circle if offered. A longer reported route includes Scarlet Sun and a nighttime psychic reading; which prerequisites are mandatory remains unclear. Scanning the graves alone does not complete the cat event.
For the separate Zombie Deer magazine, encounter the cat near the bait and bike shops in either order; daylight sightings are reported. At Benson Rentals northeast of the bait shop, look inside the office under the table for the magazine, not the porch. If closed, sleep and return. The Zombix prompt and cemetery scan are separate from the magazine unlock; verify each in-game.
Zombie Deer is reported as Jason-only. Orient using the missing-pet posters and Stone Hill sign at Benson Rentals. Hear the cat meow near each shop; avoid the unrelated couch encounter. Price unverified; a walkthrough suggests the chest-design menu.
The disappearing meow alone reportedly triggers each cat encounter; visual contact is not required. If the second encounter stalls, walk around the cemetery, try the office door, then sleep and return. After the tattoo scan, follow the cat to the central altar for a separate Curiosity scan.
Alternate sighting reported at Pay n Spray; two distinct sightings are needed according to the walkthrough. Readable real-estate ledger inside the office is separate from the tattoo. Use Focus (L3 + R3 on PS5) to keep the cat visible on the wooded path toward the cemetery. The final candle interaction after dark reportedly restores the cat; separate from both scan credits.
